title: Origin story: Freyr
description: Freyr was the son of Njord, the brightest of the Vanir, lord of Alfheim. He fell in love with the giantess Gerd and gave away his self-fighting sword to win her — a generosity that will cost him his life at Ragnarok, where he must face the fire-giant Surt weaponless.

title: Ability profile: Freyr
description: Ranked abilities: Generosity — rank 100/100; Fertility blessing — rank 98/100; Kingship — rank 93/100; Seamanship — rank 92/100; Courage — rank 90/100.

title: Power ranking: Freyr
description: Powers: Skidbladnir, the finest ship ever built; The golden boar Gullinbursti, outrunning horses; Command of sun and rain for harvests.

title: Stamina feats: Freyr
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Gave his sword knowing the prophecy of his death; Will face Surt unarmed at Ragnarok.

title: Crossover notes: Freyr
description: Freyr crosses naturally with: fertility, sunshine, prosperity, kingship.

title: Cultural impact: Freyr
description: The god who proves generosity is also a kind of courage.
